description: Project Signal node certification and 24-hour soak dashboard. Select one node, then inspect its current Run, campaign outcomes, and retained evidence.

options.content:
## One node, three answers

- **Selected node state**: how the node is doing right now.
- **Current Run verdicts**: which R01-R21 checks passed or failed in the active execution.
- **24-hour soak summary**: whether repeated Runs over the campaign are succeeding, failing, or still in progress.

Select exactly one **Node**. The **Active Run** selector drives live R01-R21 verdicts. The **Node soak campaign** selector drives the soak summary. The **Retained Run** selector drives immutable measurement evidence.

panels.title: How to read this node dashboard

panels.description: The newest certification phase for the selected node. This answers how the node is doing now, independent of its prior Runs.
panels.title: Selected node state

panels.description: Current stage number and stage name for the selected node's active Run. This is execution progress, not the 24-hour soak result.

targets.expr: max by (node, profile, suite, phase, stage, stage_index, stage_total) (project_signal_node_certification_status{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}", namespace=~"${namespace:regex}", node=~"${node:regex}", status="certifying", stage=~"${stage:regex}"})

panels.title: Current Run progress

panels.description: The selected node's current execution stage. Yellow means active work, not pass or failure.

targets.expr: sum by (stage, stage_index, stage_total) (project_signal_node_certification_status{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}", namespace=~"${namespace:regex}", node=~"${node:regex}", status="certifying", stage=~"${stage:regex}"})

panels.title: Current stage

panels.description: Live validated verdicts only. Empty means the selected active Run has not published a verdict for this stage; it is not a pass or a zero.

panels.title: Host and storage - R13-R14, R17

panels.description: Live validated verdicts only. Empty means the selected active Run has not published a verdict for this stage; it is not a pass or a zero.
panels.title: Runtime, burn-in, telemetry - R15-R16, R18, R21

panels.description: Live validated verdicts only. Empty means the selected active Run has not published a verdict for this stage; it is not a pass or a zero.
panels.title: Inference serving - R19-R20

panels.description: Current phase of the selected node's 24-hour certification campaign.
panels.title: Soak campaign state

panels.description: Seconds until the selected 24-hour campaign stops admitting new Runs. No campaign means no campaign series matches the selected node.
panels.title: Soak time remaining

panels.description: All persisted Run outcomes for the selected node's campaign. This is the primary summary of how the 24-hour soak performed.
panels.title: Soak Run outcomes

panels.description: Succeeded Runs divided by all terminal Runs in the selected campaign. A campaign can still be running while this rate evolves.
panels.title: Soak Run pass rate

panels.description: All terminal Runs retained for the selected node. Leave Retained Run on All to compare the node's Run history, or select one Run to inspect its immutable measurements below.

targets.expr: max by (run, run_uid, node, node_uid, campaign, profile, suite, phase) ((project_signal_fleet_certification_run_finished_timestamp_seconds{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}", namespace=~"${namespace:regex}", run=~"${run:regex}"} > time() - 86400) * on (namespace, run, run_uid, profile, suite) group_left (node, node_uid, campaign) project_signal_fleet_certification_run_participant_info{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}", namespace=~"${namespace:regex}", node=~"${node:regex}", campaign=~"${campaign:regex}"})

panels.title: Retained Run evidence

panels.description: Retained AIPerf output throughput for R19-R20. Zero is shown rather than discarded.
panels.title: Output throughput

panels.description: Retained AIPerf TTFT for R19-R20. Lower is better; zero is shown rather than discarded.
panels.title: Time to first token

panels.description: Minimum retained R07 BF16 assertion value by Run. Use this beside the qualification threshold defined by the certification Test.
panels.title: R07 BF16 minimum

list.definition: query_result(sort_desc(max by (run) ((timestamp(project_signal_fleet_certification_live_stage_verdict{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}", namespace=~"${namespace:regex}"}) and on (namespace, run, run_uid) (project_signal_fleet_certification_run_phase{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}", namespace=~"${namespace:regex}", phase=~"pending|running"} == 1)) * on (namespace, run, run_uid) group_left (node) project_signal_fleet_certification_run_participant_info{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}", namespace=~"${namespace:regex}", node=~"${node:regex}"})))
list.label: Active Run
list.name: active_run

query.query: query_result(sort_desc(max by (run) ((timestamp(project_signal_fleet_certification_live_stage_verdict{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}", namespace=~"${namespace:regex}"}) and on (namespace, run, run_uid) (project_signal_fleet_certification_run_phase{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}", namespace=~"${namespace:regex}", phase=~"pending|running"} == 1)) * on (namespace, run, run_uid) group_left (node) project_signal_fleet_certification_run_participant_info{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}", namespace=~"${namespace:regex}", node=~"${node:regex}"})))

list.definition: query_result(sort_desc(max by (run) ((project_signal_fleet_certification_run_finished_timestamp_seconds{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}", namespace=~"${namespace:regex}"} > 0) * on (namespace, run, run_uid, profile, suite) group_left (node, campaign) project_signal_fleet_certification_run_participant_info{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}", namespace=~"${namespace:regex}", node=~"${node:regex}", campaign=~"${campaign:regex}"})))
list.label: Retained Run
list.name: run

query.query: query_result(sort_desc(max by (run) ((project_signal_fleet_certification_run_finished_timestamp_seconds{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}", namespace=~"${namespace:regex}"} > 0) * on (namespace, run, run_uid, profile, suite) group_left (node, campaign) project_signal_fleet_certification_run_participant_info{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}", namespace=~"${namespace:regex}", node=~"${node:regex}", campaign=~"${campaign:regex}"})))
